description: Search Vivino wines, explore by type/country, look up by wine ID, or scrape a winery's full catalogue.

country.description: Filter wines by country of origin using 2-letter ISO country code (e.g. `it` for Italy, `fr` for France, `us` for USA). Case-insensitive.
country.title: Country code filter

maxItems.description: Maximum number of wine records to emit.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Filter to wines priced at or below this value in USD.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price (USD)

maxRating.description: Filter to wines with rating equal to or below this value (0–5 scale).
maxRating.title: Maximum rating

minPrice.description: Filter to wines priced at or above this value in USD.
minPrice.title: Minimum price (USD)

minRating.description: Filter to wines with rating equal to or above this value (0–5 scale).
minRating.title: Minimum rating

mode.description: What to fetch. `search` runs a free-text query; `explore` browses wines by type, country or price range; `byWineId` fetches specific wines by Vivino vintage ID (from the vintageId field in search results, or from the URL vivino.com/vintages/{id}); `winery` scrapes all wines from a winery.
enumTitles: Explore wines (browse by type / country / price)
All wines from a specific winery
mode.title: Mode

searchQuery.description: Free-text wine search query (mode=search). Example: `barolo`, `chateau petrus`, `napa valley cabernet`.
searchQuery.title: Search query

wineIds.description: List of Vivino vintage IDs to look up (mode=byWineId). The ID appears in the vintage URL, e.g. https://www.vivino.com/vintages/18745256 → use 18745256. You can get these IDs from the vintageId field in search/explore results.
wineIds.title: Vivino Vintage IDs (mode=byWineId)

wineType.description: Filter by wine type (applies to search and explore modes).
wineType.title: Wine type filter

wineryId.description: Vivino winery ID (mode=winery). The ID appears in the winery's Vivino URL path.
wineryId.title: Winery ID (mode=winery)

title: Vivino Scraper Input
